technical_gate.note: R4 removes the straight line-star failure and preserves all lifecycle/immutability gates, but the segmented pearl-and-leaf Flight and pointed Impact remain below the commercial visual floor.

visual_findings: Muzzle is materially improved: it is broad, warm, curved and readable with no rectangular card or long axial prongs. Its overall size and asymmetric lobe direction can be retained.
Flight reads as a regularly spaced garland of separate red leaf pairs and round white pearls. Gaps between groups prevent it from reading as one turbulent flame plume attached to the body.
The bright Flight cores are too circular and equal, producing a decorative bead-chain identity rather than hot gas pressure and combustion.
Impact contact and peak still contain pointed kite/star tips and a thin angular center. The silhouette should be a broad turbulent fireball, not a four-point emblem.
Impact decay is now visible and the two-to-three fragment count is restrained, but the main smoke/fire mass is small and too dark at normal viewing size.
The R4 Unity body material pass is acceptable for staging: top strap, orange chambers, frame and dark shell remain distinguishable. Do not reopen body geometry or remaps.

r5_visual_contract.body_freeze: Preserve FBX bytes/hash, 83 renderers, 34500-triangle disclosed import result, eight remaps, all GUIDs, transforms, orientation, R2-R4 evidence and the current body material values.
r5_visual_contract.muzzle: Preserve the R4 screen mass and broad three-to-five curved-lobe direction. Replace the circular white center with a slightly elongated irregular hot core and soften any remaining pointed star-like center overlap. No large redesign is needed.
r5_visual_contract.flight: Create one visibly continuous body-contact flame plume. The first hot mass must touch the rear surface; three to five unequal curved outer-lobe groups must overlap by at least half their visible length so no black gap remains. Fuse the hot cores into one irregular tapered center instead of separate round pearls. Target 0.75 to 0.95 body lengths with a warm orange/red envelope, restrained dark soot and only two small terminal embers.
r5_visual_contract.impact: Create a broad asymmetric rounded three-to-five-lobe fireball with one displaced hot core, one side-biased pressure fold and two or three short curved fragments. Remove pointed kite/star tips, axial spikes and thin center prongs. Keep a readable brown-red soot/fire decay at 0.440 seconds at normal scale.
r5_visual_contract.forbidden: No separated bead chain, equal pearl cores, detached puff train, ring, arc, line-star, needle, card, pill, straight beam, spear, radial spoke crown or four-point emblem.
r5_visual_contract.cleanup: Retain the 30-cycle natural/interrupted M/F/I gate, one-frame and plus-0.10 cleanup, zero trail/live/material/object growth, zero runtime/catalog/MFI and clean Editor state.

required_r5_evidence: Flight hero/true-macro/gameplay/rear-wake showing overlap and body contact
Impact contact/peak/0.440 decay and decay macro
unscaled Gunner_Bullet/Fighter_Attack comparison and unchanged Blender-vs-Unity body-material comparison
